title: Skill Frontmatter v1.0
description: YAML frontmatter discipline for every skill SKILL.md file (spec §9). Locks the auto-trigger contract: name + description + triggers describe when Claude fires the skill; inputs/outputs/consumes/produces describe its data contract; mcp_tools + budget + autonomy describe its runtime envelope. The 'description' field carries the human-readable Use when / Also use when / Do not use when blocks (string content, not separate fields) so glossary-audit can lint them. category mirrors the directory tree under skills/. Cross-reference: triggers.manual slash commands are listed in WORKFLOWS.md; mcp_tools.required must exist in mcp-tool-registry.schema.json; outputs '#sheet' anchors must match master-excel.schema.json logical sheet names. Validated by glossary-audit skill on every commit.

name.description: Skill slug. Must equal the directory name under skills/. kebab-case only.

description.description: Multi-line auto-trigger description containing 'Use when:', 'Also use when:', 'Do not use when:' segments per spec §9. Lints by glossary-audit; minLength enforces meaningful content.

version.description: Skill version string. SemVer-like, written as a quoted YAML string (e.g. "1.0", "1.2.3").

status.description: Lifecycle marker. active = production; deprecated = scheduled removal; wip = not yet auto-triggered.

category.description: Top-level skill grouping; must mirror skills/{category}/ directory layout (discovery, governance, ingestion, meta, planning, production, publishing, reporting).

inputs.description: Named input parameters the skill accepts at invocation. Keys are parameter names (snake_case); values declare type/default/required.

required.description: True if the skill cannot run without this input.

default.description: Default value applied when the caller omits the input. Type must match 'type'.

outputs.description: Ordered list of artifact references this skill produces. Conventions: 'master.xlsx#logical_sheet', 'outputs/reports/{date}-name.md', 'events.jsonl'. Used by the dependency graph (consumes/produces) for orphan detection.

consumes.description: Upstream artifact references this skill reads. Each entry of the form '{producer-skill}:{artifact}' so glossary-audit can build a directed dependency graph.

produces.description: Downstream skill names that consume this skill's outputs. Stored explicitly so glossary-audit detects orphans without crawling all SKILL.md files.

triggers.description: How the skill is invoked. At least one trigger surface must be populated for status=active skills (enforced by glossary-audit, not by this schema).

manual.description: Slash commands or explicit invocation aliases (e.g. ['/pseo-quickwin']).

natural_language.description: Comma-separated example phrases that should auto-trigger this skill. Used by Claude's description matcher; kept as one block string for readability.

hooks.description: Event hooks (e.g. PostToolUse, Stop) that fire this skill. Empty array if none.

scheduled.description: Cron-driven invocations for autonomy mode. Each entry pins a cron expression and an execution mode (report-only vs auto-execute).

mode.description: report-only writes a report and exits; auto-execute may mutate Excel/state without prompting.

mcp_tools.description: Declares which MCP tools the skill calls. required tools are hard dependencies; optional tools are used opportunistically. Tool names must exist in mcp-tool-registry.schema.json.

required.description: Tools the skill cannot run without.

optional.description: Tools used when available; absence does not block the skill.

budget.description: Cost envelope. Skills that touch paid MCPs (DataForSEO, paid Scrapling) must set uses_paid_mcp=true; the budget skill blocks execution when estimated_credits exceeds project.config thresholds.

uses_paid_mcp.description: True if any required or optional MCP tool is paid.

estimated_credits.description: Best-effort upper-bound credit estimate per run. 0 when free.

autonomy.description: Autonomous-mode policy. Determines whether the skill may execute without human approval and how confident the skill is in its own outputs.

confidence.description: Self-reported reliability tier; LOW skills route through extra review.

requires_approval.description: True forces an awaiting_approval gate before destructive output (publishes, applied changes).

safe_auto_execute.description: True allows scheduled cron triggers to run end-to-end without a human session; false means scheduled runs must stop at a report.
